title: Shortest Paths
statementMd:
You are given a graph of $n$ nodes and $m$ undirected edges. Find the [shortest path](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shortest_path_problem) from node $1$ to each node with Dikjstra's algorithm.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $n$ and $m$ $(2 \leq n \leq 100, 0 \leq m \leq \frac{n(n-1)}{2})$.

The following $m$ lines contain $3$ integers each: $u$, $v$, and $w$, denoting an undirected edge from $u$ to $v$ with weight $w$ $(1 \leq u, v \leq n, 0 \leq w \leq 10^5)$.

## Output

Output the shortest path from node $1$ to each node $2, \dots, n$. If a node is not reachable from node $1$, output $-1$.
statementZhMd:
给定一个包含 $n$ 个节点和 $m$ 条无向边的图。请使用 Dikjstra 算法求出从节点 $1$ 到每个节点的[最短路径](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shortest_path_problem)。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $n$ 和 $m$ $(2 \leq n \leq 100, 0 \leq m \leq \frac{n(n-1)}{2})$。

接下来的 $m$ 行，每行包含 $3$ 个整数：$u$、$v$ 和 $w$，表示一条从 $u$ 到 $v$、权重为 $w$ 的无向边 $(1 \leq u, v \leq n, 0 \leq w \leq 10^5)$。

## 输出格式

输出从节点 $1$ 到每个节点 $2, \dots, n$ 的最短路径。如果某个节点无法从节点 $1$ 到达，则输出 $-1$。
